    "text": "mfs_payments_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-01-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-payment-api. Schema version: v2026.09.15. Migration tool: Alembic. Total estimated rows: 142M. Used by: mfs-payment-gateway (mfs-pay-pod-01). Table: payments. Primary table for all payment records. Columns: payment_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to mfs_customers_db.customers), amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL, stored in minor units), currency (VARCHAR(3), NOT NULL, FK to currencies), card_token (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, references Token Vault), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, default 'pending'), description (TEXT), idempotency_key (VARCHAR(128), UNIQUE), fraud_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), processor_response (JSONB), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~68M. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Retention: indefinite. Table: transactions. Individual transaction events within a payment lifecycle. Columns: txn_id (UUID, PK), payment_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to payments), type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: authorization, capture, refund, chargeback, void), amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL), processor_response (JSONB), processor_txn_id (VARCHAR(128)), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~52M. One payment may have multiple transactions (authorize, capture, partial refund, etc.). Table: currencies. Supported currency reference table. Columns: currency_code (VARCHAR(3), PK), name (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), decimal_places (INTEGER, NOT NULL), active (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default true). Row count: 6 (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY). Table: settlements. Batch settlement records. Columns: settlement_id (UUID, PK), batch_date (DATE, NOT NULL), total_amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL), transaction_count (INTEGER, NOT NULL), currency (VARCHAR(3), NOT NULL, FK to currencies), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL), processor_id (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), processor_response (JSONB), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), settled_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), reconciled_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~12K. One batch per day per currency per processor. Table: audit_log. Payment-level audit trail. Columns: log_id (BIGSERIAL, PK), payment_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to payments), action (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), actor (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, typically a service account like svc-payment-api), details (JSONB), ip_address (INET), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~22M. Retention: 7 years (PCI DSS requirement). Indexes. payments_customer_id_idx ON payments(customer_id). payments_status_created_idx ON payments(status, created_at). payments_idempotency_key_uniq ON payments(idempotency_key) UNIQUE. transactions_payment_id_idx ON transactions(payment_id). transactions_type_created_idx ON transactions(type, created_at). settlements_batch_date_idx ON settlements(batch_date). audit_log_payment_id_idx ON audit_log(payment_id). audit_log_created_at_idx ON audit_log(created_at). Foreign Keys. payments.currency -> currencies.currency_code. transactions.payment_id -> payments.payment_id. settlements.currency -> currencies.currency_code. audit_log.payment_id -> payments.payment_id.",

    "text": "mfs_fraud_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-02-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-fraud-engine. Schema version: v2026.09.20. Migration tool: Alembic. Total estimated rows: 88M. Used by: mfs-fraud-engine (mfs-fraud-pod-01). Table: fraud_scores. Fraud scoring results for every evaluated transaction. Columns: score_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), ml_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL, range 0.0000-1.0000), rule_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL), final_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL), risk_level (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: low, medium, high, critical), model_version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'fraud-xgb-v4.2'), signals (JSONB, array of signal objects), latency_ms (INTEGER), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~68M. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Score published to fraud-scores Kafka topic on kafka-broker.mfs.internal. Table: velocity_windows. Sliding window aggregates for velocity-based fraud detection. Columns: window_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL), window_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: 1min, 5min, 1hour, 24hour), count (INTEGER, NOT NULL, default 0), sum_amount (BIGINT, NOT NULL, default 0), window_start (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), window_end (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8M active windows. Managed by VelocityMonitor in engine/velocity.py. Real-time windows are cached in redis-cluster.mfs.internal and persisted to this table periodically. Table: aml_alerts. Anti-money laundering alerts generated by the AML rule engine. Columns: alert_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL), rule_id (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, e.g. STRUCT-001, RAPID-001, GEO-001, MERCH-001), severity (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: low, medium, high, critical), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, default 'open', one of: open, under_review, cleared, escalated), analyst_notes (TEXT), reviewer_id (VARCHAR(128)), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), reviewed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~45K. Published to aml-alerts Kafka topic. Table: models. ML model metadata and versioning. Columns: model_id (UUID, PK), name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, UNIQUE), algorithm (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), f1_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), precision_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), recall_score (NUMERIC(5,4)), auc_roc (NUMERIC(5,4)), training_data_rows (BIGINT), deployed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: training, staging, production, canary, retired), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~25. Current production: fraud-xgb-v4.2 (F1=0.9612, deployed 2026-09-20). Canary: fraud-xgb-v4.3 (F1=0.9654, 5% traffic, deployed 2026-09-28). Artifacts stored in MLflow at mlflow.mfs.internal:5000. Table: features. Extracted feature vectors for model training and auditing. Columns: feature_id (UUID, PK), txn_id (UUID, NOT NULL), feature_vector (JSONB, NOT NULL), extraction_time_ms (INTEGER), extractor_version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~12M (retained 90 days for retraining). Computed by FeatureExtractor in features/extractor.py. Indexes. fraud_scores_txn_id_uniq ON fraud_scores(txn_id) UNIQUE. fraud_scores_risk_level_created_idx ON fraud_scores(risk_level, created_at). fraud_scores_final_score_idx ON fraud_scores(final_score). velocity_windows_customer_type_idx ON velocity_windows(customer_id, window_type). aml_alerts_status_created_idx ON aml_alerts(status, created_at). aml_alerts_customer_id_idx ON aml_alerts(customer_id). models_version_uniq ON models(version) UNIQUE. models_status_idx ON models(status). features_txn_id_idx ON features(txn_id). Foreign Keys. No cross-database foreign keys. Referential integrity to mfs_payments_db.transactions.txn_id is enforced at the application level in engine/scorer.py.",

    "text": "mfs_customers_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-04.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-04-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-customer-svc. Schema version: v2026.08.10. Total estimated rows: 24M. Used by: mfs-customer-portal backend. Table: customers. Core customer records. Columns: customer_id (UUID, PK), first_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field), last_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), email_hash (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, SHA-256 hash via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for search), phone_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash), kyc_status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: pending, verified, rejected, expired), tier (VARCHAR(16), default 'standard', one of: standard, premium, platinum), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8.2M. PII fields are encrypted at the application level using EncryptionUtil from mfs-common-libs (auth/encryption.py). Table: accounts. Customer financial accounts. Columns: account_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), account_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: checking, savings, credit, investment), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, suspended, closed), balance_snapshot (BIGINT, minor units, updated nightly), opened_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), closed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~12M. Table: cards. Payment cards linked to customer accounts. Columns: card_id (UUID, PK), account_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to accounts), token (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, references Token Vault, no PAN stored), card_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: debit, credit, prepaid), card_brand (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: visa, mastercard, amex, discover), last_four (VARCHAR(4), NOT NULL), expiry_month (INTEGER, NOT NULL), expiry_year (INTEGER, NOT NULL), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, expired, blocked, replaced), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~3.5M. No raw card numbers are stored. All card data is tokenized via Token Vault API. Table: addresses. Customer address records. Columns: address_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: billing, shipping, home, work), line1_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), line2_enc (BYTEA), city (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), state (VARCHAR(64)), postal_code (VARCHAR(20), NOT NULL), country (VARCHAR(2), NOT NULL, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Row count: ~5.8M. PII Encryption. PII fields (first_name, last_name, address lines) are encrypted using AES-256-CBC via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field from mfs-common-libs. Email and phone are stored as SHA-256 hashes via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for lookup. Decryption requires EncryptionUtil.decrypt_field with keys from vault.mfs.internal. This design satisfies PCI DSS requirement 3.4 for protection of stored cardholder data and CCPA requirements for PII protection. Indexes. customers_email_hash_idx ON customers(email_hash). customers_kyc_status_idx ON customers(kyc_status). accounts_customer_id_idx ON accounts(customer_id). cards_account_id_idx ON cards(account_id). cards_token_idx ON cards(token). addresses_customer_id_idx ON addresses(customer_id).",

    "text": "mfs_audit_db Schema Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-03-ro.mfs.internal. Service account: svc-notification-svc. Schema version: v2026.09.01. Total estimated rows: 310M. Used by: mfs-common-libs (logging/audit.py), all services via AuditLogger. This database is the central audit repository for all Meridian Financial Services applications. All audit writes go through the AuditLogger class in mfs-common-libs. Table: audit_events. General audit events from all services. Columns: event_id (UUID, PK), service_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'mfs-payment-gateway', 'mfs-fraud-engine'), event_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment.created', 'token.created', 'fraud.scored', 'auth.login'), severity (VARCHAR(16), default 'info', one of: debug, info, warning, error, critical), actor (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, service account or user identifier), resource_type (VARCHAR(64)), resource_id (VARCHAR(256)), details (JSONB), correlation_id (UUID), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~180M. Written by AuditLogger.log_event. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Table: access_logs. Data access audit trail for compliance. Columns: log_id (UUID, PK), service_account (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'svc-payment-api', 'svc-fraud-engine'), resource_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment', 'customer', 'card_token', 'fraud_score'), resource_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), action (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: read, write, delete, export), ip_address (INET), user_agent (VARCHAR(256)), success (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default true), failure_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~95M. Written by AuditLogger.log_access. Critical for PCI DSS audit trail. Table: change_records. Field-level change tracking for sensitive data. Columns: record_id (UUID, PK), entity_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'customer', 'payment', 'card', 'aml_alert'), entity_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), field_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), old_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), new_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), changed_by (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), change_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~35M. Written by AuditLogger.log_change. Values are stored as hashes to avoid persisting sensitive data in the audit trail. Retention Policy. All audit data is retained for 7 years per PCI DSS requirement 10.7. Partitions older than 7 years are archived to cold storage at backup.mfs.internal and then dropped. Archive verification is performed monthly. Log integrity is maintained via hash chains: each event includes a hash of the previous event's ID and timestamp, making tampering detectable. Indexes. audit_events_service_created_idx ON audit_events(service_name, created_at). audit_events_event_type_idx ON audit_events(event_type). audit_events_actor_idx ON audit_events(actor). audit_events_correlation_idx ON audit_events(correlation_id). access_logs_service_account_idx ON access_logs(service_account). access_logs_resource_type_id_idx ON access_logs(resource_type, resource_id). access_logs_created_at_idx ON access_logs(created_at). change_records_entity_type_id_idx ON change_records(entity_type, entity_id). change_records_created_at_idx ON change_records(created_at).",

    "text": "mfs_fraud_db Extended Table Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-02-ro.mfs.internal. Schema version: v2026.09.28. Total estimated rows: 112M across all tables. Table: fraud_transactions. Fraud-enriched transaction records. Columns: id (UUID, PK), payment_id (UUID, NOT NULL, references mfs_payments_db.payments at application level), fraud_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL), model_version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), features_json (JSONB, NOT NULL, full feature vector used for scoring), scored_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~68M. Partitioned by scored_at (monthly). Table: fraud_scores. Detailed fraud scoring breakdown. Columns: id (UUID, PK), transaction_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to fraud_transactions), score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL, final composite score), confidence (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL, model confidence interval), model_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to model_registry), explanation_json (JSONB, SHAP values and feature contributions). Row count: ~68M. Table: model_registry. Central registry of all ML models. Columns: id (UUID, PK), name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, UNIQUE), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: training, staging, champion, challenger, retired), metrics_json (JSONB, training and validation metrics including AUC, precision, recall, F1), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~30. Table: model_versions. Detailed model version tracking with champion/challenger designation. Columns: id (UUID, PK), model_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to model_registry), version (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL), champion_flag (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default false), performance_baseline_json (JSONB, baseline metrics for drift detection including feature distributions, KL-divergence thresholds). Row count: ~30. Table: ab_test_results. A/B test results for model comparison. Columns: id (UUID, PK), model_a_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to model_registry), model_b_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to model_registry), traffic_split (NUMERIC(3,2), NOT NULL, e.g. 0.95/0.05), metrics_json (JSONB, comparative metrics: AUC delta, precision delta, recall delta, false positive rate delta, statistical significance p-value), start_date (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), end_date (TIMESTAMPTZ), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: running, completed, cancelled). Row count: ~15. Table: velocity_windows. Sliding window transaction velocity aggregates. Columns: account_id (UUID, NOT NULL), window_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: 1min, 5min, 1hour, 24hour), count (INTEGER, NOT NULL, default 0), last_updated (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~8M active windows. Composite PK: (account_id, window_type). Table: alerts. Rule-triggered fraud and AML alerts. Columns: id (UUID, PK), rule_id (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, e.g. STRUCT-001, RAPID-001, GEO-001, MERCH-001, VELOCITY-001), severity (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: low, medium, high, critical), account_id (UUID, NOT NULL), transaction_ids (UUID[], array of related transaction IDs), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~52K. Table: aml_cases. Anti-money laundering investigation cases. Columns: id (UUID, PK), alert_ids (UUID[], NOT NULL, array of FK references to alerts), pattern_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. structuring, rapid_movement, layering, smurfing), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: open, investigating, escalated, closed_cleared, closed_filed), analyst_id (VARCHAR(128)), assigned_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), closed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~2.1K. Table: sar_filings. Suspicious Activity Report filings to FinCEN. Columns: id (UUID, PK), case_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to aml_cases), filing_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: initial, supplemental, corrected), fincen_id (VARCHAR(64), FinCEN tracking number assigned after submission), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: draft, submitted, accepted, rejected), filed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~180. Table: fraud_cases. Fraud investigation case tracking. Columns: id (UUID, PK), priority (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: NEW, ASSIGNED, IN_REVIEW, DISPOSITION, CLOSED), assigned_analyst (VARCHAR(128)), evidence_ids (UUID[], array of FK references to case_evidence), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), closed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~4.8K. Table: case_evidence. Evidence artifacts linked to fraud investigation cases. Columns: id (UUID, PK), case_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to fraud_cases), source_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: transaction, fraud_score, aml_alert, customer_record, external), source_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL, reference to source system record), data_json (JSONB, evidence details and metadata). Row count: ~28K. Table: case_dispositions. Investigation decision records. Columns: id (UUID, PK), case_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to fraud_cases), decision (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: confirmed_fraud, false_positive, suspicious_activity, insufficient_evidence), rationale (TEXT, NOT NULL), analyst_id (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~3.9K. Service Account Access. svc-fraud-engine: read/write access to fraud_transactions, fraud_scores, model_registry, model_versions, ab_test_results, alerts. Primary service account for scoring pipeline. svc-txn-monitor: read/write access to velocity_windows. Used by VelocityMonitor for real-time sliding window updates. svc-aml-engine: read/write access to aml_cases, sar_filings, alerts. Used for AML investigation workflow and SAR filing. svc-case-engine: read/write access to fraud_cases, case_evidence, case_dispositions. Used by the case management service. svc-model-serving: read access to model_registry, model_versions. Used by ModelServing for loading model metadata and artifacts.",

    "text": "mfs_customers_db Extended Table Documentation. Connection Details. Host: pghost-prod-03.mfs.internal. Port: 5432. Read replica: pghost-prod-03-ro.mfs.internal. Schema version: v2026.09.25. Total estimated rows: 32M across all tables. Used by: mfs-kyc-engine (mfs-kyc-pod-01). Table: customers. Core customer identity records. Columns: id (UUID, PK), name (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL, encrypted PII via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field), email (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL, SHA-256 hash via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii), kyc_status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: pending, verified, rejected, expired, manual_review), risk_level (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, default 'standard', one of: low, standard, elevated, high), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8.2M. KYC status is updated by the KYC verification pipeline. Risk level is computed from verification results and sanctions screening. Table: document_verifications. Identity document verification records. Columns: id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), document_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: passport, drivers_license, national_id), ocr_result_json (JSONB, NOT NULL, extracted document fields: name, date_of_birth, document_number, expiry_date, country, issuing_authority), authenticity_score (NUMERIC(5,4), NOT NULL, range 0.0000-1.0000, document authenticity confidence), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: pending, processing, verified, rejected, manual_review), submitted_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()), completed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Schema version: v2026.08.10. Total estimated rows: 24M. Used by: mfs-customer-portal backend. Table: customers. Core customer records. Columns: customer_id (UUID, PK), first_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field), last_name_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), email_hash (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, SHA-256 hash via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for search), phone_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash), kyc_status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: pending, verified, rejected, expired), tier (VARCHAR(16), default 'standard', one of: standard, premium, platinum), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~8.2M. PII fields are encrypted at the application level using EncryptionUtil from mfs-common-libs (auth/encryption.py). Table: accounts. Customer financial accounts. Columns: account_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), account_type (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: checking, savings, credit, investment), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, suspended, closed), balance_snapshot (BIGINT, minor units, updated nightly), opened_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL), closed_at (TIMESTAMPTZ). Row count: ~12M. Table: cards. Payment cards linked to customer accounts. Columns: card_id (UUID, PK), account_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to accounts), token (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, references Token Vault, no PAN stored), card_type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: debit, credit, prepaid), card_brand (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: visa, mastercard, amex, discover), last_four (VARCHAR(4), NOT NULL), expiry_month (INTEGER, NOT NULL), expiry_year (INTEGER, NOT NULL), status (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: active, expired, blocked, replaced), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL). Row count: ~3.5M. No raw card numbers are stored. All card data is tokenized via Token Vault API. Table: addresses. Customer address records. Columns: address_id (UUID, PK), customer_id (UUID, NOT NULL, FK to customers), type (VARCHAR(16), NOT NULL, one of: billing, shipping, home, work), line1_enc (BYTEA, NOT NULL, encrypted PII), line2_enc (BYTEA), city (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), state (VARCHAR(64)), postal_code (VARCHAR(20), NOT NULL), country (VARCHAR(2), NOT NULL, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Row count: ~5.8M. PII Encryption. PII fields (first_name, last_name, address lines) are encrypted using AES-256-CBC via EncryptionUtil.encrypt_field from mfs-common-libs. Email and phone are stored as SHA-256 hashes via EncryptionUtil.hash_pii for lookup. Decryption requires EncryptionUtil.decrypt_field with keys from vault.mfs.internal. This design satisfies PCI DSS requirement 3.4 for protection of stored cardholder data and CCPA requirements for PII protection. This database is the central audit repository for all Meridian Financial Services applications. All audit writes go through the AuditLogger class in mfs-common-libs. Table: audit_events. General audit events from all services. Columns: event_id (UUID, PK), service_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'mfs-payment-gateway', 'mfs-fraud-engine'), event_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment.created', 'token.created', 'fraud.scored', 'auth.login'), severity (VARCHAR(16), default 'info', one of: debug, info, warning, error, critical), actor (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, service account or user identifier), resource_type (VARCHAR(64)), resource_id (VARCHAR(256)), details (JSONB), correlation_id (UUID), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~180M. Written by AuditLogger.log_event. Partitioned by created_at (monthly). Table: access_logs. Data access audit trail for compliance. Columns: log_id (UUID, PK), service_account (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL, e.g. 'svc-payment-api', 'svc-fraud-engine'), resource_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'payment', 'customer', 'card_token', 'fraud_score'), resource_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), action (VARCHAR(32), NOT NULL, one of: read, write, delete, export), ip_address (INET), user_agent (VARCHAR(256)), success (BOOLEAN, NOT NULL, default true), failure_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~95M. Written by AuditLogger.log_access. Critical for PCI DSS audit trail. Table: change_records. Field-level change tracking for sensitive data. Columns: record_id (UUID, PK), entity_type (VARCHAR(64), NOT NULL, e.g. 'customer', 'payment', 'card', 'aml_alert'), entity_id (VARCHAR(256), NOT NULL), field_name (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), old_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), new_value_hash (VARCHAR(64), SHA-256 hash, NOT NULL), changed_by (VARCHAR(128), NOT NULL), change_reason (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMPTZ, NOT NULL, default NOW()). Row count: ~35M. Written by AuditLogger.log_change. Values are stored as hashes to avoid persisting sensitive data in the audit trail. Retention Policy. All audit data is retained for 7 years per PCI DSS requirement 10.7. Partitions older than 7 years are archived to cold storage at backup.mfs.internal and then dropped. Archive verification is performed monthly. Log integrity is maintained via hash chains: each event includes a hash of the previous event's ID and timestamp, making tampering detectable. data.title: Schema Versioning & Migration Overview
data.text: Schema Versioning & Migration Overview. Last updated: 2026-09-30 by Jordan Lee. This document describes the schema migration process for all MFS production databases. Migration Tool. All MFS databases use Flyway for schema versioning and migration management. Flyway version: 9.22. Migration execution is integrated into the GitLab CI/CD pipeline as a pre-deployment step. Migrations run with the deployer service account svc-cicd-deployer which has DDL privileges on all production databases. Migration Naming Convention. All migration files follow the naming convention: V{version}__{description}.sql. Version numbers are sequential integers scoped to each database. Description uses snake_case and must clearly describe the schema change. Examples: V47__add_webhook_tables.sql, V48__add_analytics_aggregates.sql. Down migrations (rollbacks) follow: U{version}__{description}.sql. Source Control. All migration files are stored in GitLab at gitlab.mfs.internal in the respective service repository under the db/migrations/ directory. mfs-payment-gateway migrations: gitlab.mfs.internal/mfs/payment-gateway/db/migrations/. mfs-fraud-engine migrations: gitlab.mfs.internal/mfs/fraud-engine/db/migrations/. mfs-common-libs migrations (audit db): gitlab.mfs.internal/mfs/common-libs/db/migrations/. Migration files are code-reviewed with the same rigor as application code. Approval Process. Production migrations require approval from: 1. The owning squad lead (Arjun Deshmukh for payments, Priya Natarajan for fraud, Marcus Thompson for platform). 2. A DBA review from Platform Engineering (Aisha Obi). 3. For migrations affecting tables with > 10M rows: performance impact assessment required. 4. For migrations adding or modifying indexes: execution plan review required. Migrations are first applied to staging databases on ocp-staging.mfs.internal and validated before production execution. Recent Migrations - mfs_payments_db. V47__add_webhook_tables.sql: Added webhook_registrations and webhook_deliveries tables for the webhook API. Applied: 2026-09-10. V48__add_analytics_aggregates.sql: Added materialized views for transaction analytics aggregation. Applied: 2026-09-15. V49__add_settlement_batches.sql: Added settlement_batch_items table linking individual transactions to settlement batches. Applied: 2026-09-22. Recent Migrations - mfs_fraud_db. V23__add_kyc_tables.sql: Added document_verifications, identity_checks, sanctions_hits, and liveness_results tables. Note: These tables were later moved to mfs_customers_db via data migration. Applied: 2026-08-20. V24__add_case_management_tables.sql: Added fraud_cases, case_evidence, and case_dispositions tables for the case management service. Applied: 2026-09-01. V25__add_ab_test_results.sql: Added ab_test_results table for model A/B testing tracking. Applied: 2026-09-15. V26__add_sar_filings.sql: Added sar_filings table for Suspicious Activity Report tracking. Applied: 2026-09-20. Rollback Procedures. Each migration has a corresponding rollback script (U{version}__*.sql). Rollbacks are executed via Flyway undo command through the GitLab CI/CD pipeline. Rollback requires the same approval process as forward migrations. Data-destructive rollbacks (dropping columns or tables) require VP Engineering approval. All rollback executions are logged to mfs_audit_db via AuditLogger.
